title: Cluster v1
description: Body of GET /cluster on the app backend (P3.11): the vLLM pods, their queues and the cluster's remaining work, read from Prometheus with the Grafana panels' queries, so the two differ by at most one scrape.

remaining_work.description: sum(thesis_remaining_work): every active run's max(expected-steps - step, 1) (D2, P3.8). 0 when no run is active.

active_runs.description: sum(thesis_active_runs). 0 when no run is active.

poll_seconds.description: How long the UI waits before asking again: the profile's Prometheus scrape interval, since nothing changes sooner.

pods.description: One entry per vLLM pod Kubernetes lists, sorted by name.

state.description: D14's pod states. draining: Kubernetes is deleting the pod (until P4.3 adds a drain before it). failed: phase Failed or Unknown. ready: Running and Ready. starting: anything else.

queue.description: vllm:num_requests_waiting; null until the pod's metrics are scraped, so it never reads as 0.
